tasks.title: Reopen tasks without resolving unrelated legacy packets
tasks.objective: Calculate descendants from active immutable packet dependencies where present and otherwise from the validated current DAG, preserving existing reopen invariants and unrelated legacy packet bytes.
tasks.test_seam: A completed task can be reopened while an unrelated no-revision task has malformed legacy packet bytes; the operation leaves the unrelated task untouched and its packet byte-identical. Existing tests prove descendants still invalidate and active-revision resolution still fails closed.

tasks.title: Independently evaluate reopen dependency selection
tasks.objective: Try to falsify descendant selection and reopen safety, including active revision resolution, unrelated malformed legacy packets, state-lock scope, target status checks, and descendant invalidation compatibility.
tasks.test_seam: Fresh-context review of the helper, locked reopen path, regression test, and existing descendant invalidation tests; attempt a stale active-revision case and malformed unrelated legacy packet case.
